Write a report's render parameters to csv

Source: R/io-export.R
write_input_params.Rd

Builds a one-row-per-parameter long-format data frame — package version, render timestamp, then every entry of params flattened to a string — and writes it via write.csv_rawr(). Deliberately a plain input_params.csv rather than a prepended xlsx sheet (a documented deviation from the style guide's "first sheet is always input_params" convention): assigning the table to a local variable named input_params lets write.csv_rawr()'s deparse(substitute()) filename trick produce exactly <prefix>_input_params.csv / input_params.csv for free.

Usage

write_input_params(params, folder, prefix = NULL)

Arguments

params

The Rmd params list passed to the report at render time.

folder

Destination directory for the csv.

prefix

Optional string prepended to the filename, forwarded to write.csv_rawr().

Value

Invisible NULL; called for its side effect of writing input_params.csv.

Details

Always called once per render from the template's final export block, independent of CsvSave/xlsx exports — input_params.csv is part of the "always written" tier alongside pep_all.csv/ counts_pep_all_condition.csv/seq_by_condition.xlsx.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
write_input_params(params, folder = FolderResults)
} # }
